title: Tenant-shard residency fencing and automated retention audit generator
creator: Avery Chen
description: Build a repeatable system that (1) fences tenant shards to declared geographic regions, (2) continuously verifies per-tenant retention policy compliance, and (3) emits cryptographically-signed audit packages for customers and internal auditors. This task covers the pipeline, tenancy mapping, retention enforcement hooks, and report schema. The generator will create both a machine-readable snapshot (JSON manifest + signature) and a human-readable summary (PDF/HTML) stored alongside the tenant's dedicated storage bucket and surfaced in the Console. The implementation must be pluggable so Dedicated and Private deployments reuse the same verification logic but differ in signing backend and storage endpoints.
acceptance_criteria: Per-tenant shard residency mapping produced on-demand and on schedule with region and node-level metadata
Retention scan that flags objects (logs, cached segments) exceeding tenant policy and surfaces remediation actions
Signed audit package includes manifest, retention status, evidence links, and signature verifiable with customer KMS or platform verification endpoint
Console displays latest snapshot timestamp, retention compliance status, and download link for signed package
End-to-end test coverage for pipeline, including simulated cross-region drift and a failure mode where signing backend is unreachable (fallback behavior documented)
Performance: generation for a typical tenant (<=100 nodes) completes within 3 minutes and is schedulable daily without impacting serving SLOs
implementation_notes: We selected a hybrid approach: streaming changefeed for near-real-time fence alerts + nightly snapshot for signed audits to balance cost and timeliness.
Signing strategy: use customer KMS for Private deployments; use internal signing key stored in Dedicated HSM with auditable rotation for Hosted Dedicated.
Storage: audit packages written to tenant-dedicated S3 prefix + index written to central audit catalog for searchability.
Trade-offs considered: full real-time attestation was rejected due to high load on control plane; opted for hybrid to keep serving overhead minimal.
Rollout will start behind a feature flag for 10 pilot tenants to validate scale and UX before broad enablement.

qa_plan: Unit tests for retention scanner rules
